description: What each placement shows one contact now: for each key, the contact's highest-priority open placement item (ties: newest), or null when the slot collapses. Identify the contact by email, externalId or subscriberId. Reading marks nothing displayed.

actions.description: Comma-separated button actions the app handles beyond open_url and dismiss, e.g. "request_push_permission". Items with other actions are skipped.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

externalId.description: Contact external ID from your app.

name: get_in_app_placement_content

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_in_app_placement_content` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

placements.description: One {placement, message} per requested key; message is null when the slot collapses.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
